name: Mesh
_comment_chain: Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum Orbit L2, chainId 4663) via a Pons launch — the internal docs repo. deployNetwork picks config/deploy.<network>.json (MESH_DEPLOY_NETWORK overrides; use robinhood-testnet for the rehearsal).
_comment_tradeFeeBps: Pons: 1% base fee (creator keeps 70% of it) + creatorTaxBps 80 (100% to creator) ≈ 1.5% of volume to the creator = us. Informative for the web copy; fees are set at launch on Pons, not here.

requestPricing._comment: Upstream-served requests bill OpenRouter list x (1 + upstreamMarkupBps/10000) or x (1 - upstreamDiscountBps/10000); exactly one may be non-zero. upstreamFeeBps is what OpenRouter charges Mesh on top of list when it buys inference credits (5.5% on card top-ups), so the real cost is list x 1.055 and the 6% markup leaves 0.5% of list as margin; a markup below the fee, or any discount, is a loss the treasury funds (docs/PRICING.md). Network-served requests bill the flat networkPricePerMTokens.

nodeRewards._comment: usdPerMTokens is the base reward. A stake multiplier lifts it, but never above maxShareOfPriceBps of what the user paid for the job (9000 = 90% of $0.08 = $0.072/M), so the network leg always keeps at least a 10% margin.

deposits._comment: Self-serve prepaid top-ups: send USDG on Robinhood Chain to `receiver`, paste the tx hash on the Market page, the gateway verifies the transfer and credits the balance. Off until receiver + tokens are filled (the dev supplies the stablecoin addresses; receiver = the treasury multisig).

usageShare._comment: Holders earn from paid usage (docs/PRICING.md, engine 2). On from launch: network price 0.08/M, node cost 0.06/M (at most 0.072/M for a staked node), so 0.008-0.02/M of margin of which holderBps joins the hourly pool; frontier requests bill list + 6% against a cost of list + 5.5%, so 0.5% of list is margin.

starterCredits._comment: A wallet that holds at least minHoldTokens is credited amountUsd (ledger kind starter) on its first sign-in. Once per wallet, maxWallets total (0 = unlimited), 3 per IP hash per day. transferable false: starter credits can be spent on inference but not listed on the marketplace. Pause at runtime with POST /admin/starter/toggle.

creditExpiry._comment: Every credit lapses `days` after it landed, whatever its source; the oldest credit is spent first. A cancelled or expired listing returns credit with its original date. Lapsed credit lowers what the reserve has to cover, so its backing shows as reserve surplus (docs/PRICING.md, section 6).

directSales._comment: Buy credits from Mesh at face value with the prepaid USD balance (POST /me/credits/buy). The payment backs the credit 1:1 (docs/PRICING.md, section 7).

reserve._comment: The holder share of each sweep is swapped to the stablecoin and held in the credit-pool wallet. GET /report totals.reserve publishes that balance next to credits outstanding and flags it as short below minCoverageBps (docs/PRICING.md, section 5).
